attachments_parent_state_check.name: attachments_parent_state_check
attachments_parent_state_check.value: ("attachments"."status" = 'attached' and num_nonnulls("attachments"."feedback_id", "attachments"."comment_id") = 1 and "attachments"."attached_at" is not null) or ("attachments"."status" <> 'attached' and "attachments"."feedback_id" is null and "attachments"."comment_id" is null and "attachments"."attached_at" is null)

integration_connections_owner_scope_chec.name: integration_connections_owner_scope_check
integration_connections_owner_scope_chec.value: ("integration_connections"."scope" = 'personal' and "integration_connections"."owner_user_id" is not null) or ("integration_connections"."scope" = 'workspace' and "integration_connections"."owner_user_id" is null)

reactions_feedback_user_unique.name: reactions_feedback_user_unique
reactions_feedback_user_unique.where: "reactions"."feedback_id" is not null and "reactions"."user_id" is not null

reactions_feedback_guest_actor_unique.name: reactions_feedback_guest_actor_unique
reactions_feedback_guest_actor_unique.where: "reactions"."feedback_id" is not null and "reactions"."guest_actor_id" is not null

reactions_comment_user_unique.name: reactions_comment_user_unique
reactions_comment_user_unique.where: "reactions"."comment_id" is not null and "reactions"."user_id" is not null

reactions_comment_guest_actor_unique.name: reactions_comment_guest_actor_unique
reactions_comment_guest_actor_unique.where: "reactions"."comment_id" is not null and "reactions"."guest_actor_id" is not null
